trusted_basis.title: G4.6 Canvas Interaction Presentation Architecture v0.1
G4.6 Canvas Interaction Presentation Baseline Implementation Plan v0.1

entry_control.statement: G4.5 is formally closed; G4.6 successor execution is authorized by the user control instruction on 2026-10-06.
entry_control.state_cache_note: .aegis/state.json is known stale and is not Authority; do not reopen G4.5 solely because the generated cache lags.

frozen_statements: G4.6 introduces no new canonical ObjectKind or Operation.
Selection/handle/hover state is per-view transient editor state and never enters SemanticDocument or shared RuntimeScene.
Transform preview reuses G4 TransformSession + TransientSceneOverride; pointer-move frames emit zero canonical operations and commit emits one final SetTransforms.
Selection chrome is vector/screen-space presentation with visual size independent from hit slop.
Existing G4 selection/transform semantics, Undo/Redo, input routing, brush engine, Arc ownership, and canonical mutation semantics are reused rather than rebuilt.
forbidden_authority_expansion: No G6 RichText editing/IME/editor overlay work.
No canonical schema/property additions for editor chrome.
